name: Rune of Might
desc: Carving pattern, available from Runecarving 1. On a Fair slab: weapon +4 Damage, armor +2 Armor, accessory +2% Damage. Slab grade scales the result.

name: Rune of Warding
desc: Carving pattern, available from Runecarving 1. On a Fair slab: weapon +2% Parry, armor +4 Armor, accessory +12 Max HP. Slab grade scales the result.

name: Rune of Swiftness
desc: Carving pattern, Runecarving 5. On a Fair slab: weapon +4% Attack Speed, armor +2% Speed, accessory +3% Speed. Slab grade scales the result.

name: Rune of the Edge
desc: Carving pattern, Runecarving 12. On a Fair slab: weapon +3% Crit and +15% Crit Damage, accessory +2% Crit. Does nothing in armor. Slab grade scales the result.
